name: application-rate-us-prompt
title: Rate Us Prompt
description: In-app star rating prompt components with a positive-feedback branch and a low-rating feedback branch, for app-store review requests.
useWhen: In-app star rating prompt components with a positive-feedback branch and a low-rating feedback branch, for app-store review requests.
avoidWhen: Avoid rate us prompt when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Rate Us Prompt uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Associate each form field with a visible or programmatic label before production use.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
